title: Crash on launch of Mobile renderer project on MacBook Air, fallback to Open GL 3 (compatibility) not triggering
body: ### Tested versions Reproducable in 4.7.2 Not reproducable in 4.1 - 4.3 ### System information MacBook Air Retina (2020) with macOS 15.7.9 ### Issue description I've recently updated an old project using Mobile renderer, originally developed in Godot 4.1-4.3 to Godot 4.7.2. On testing the exported game on an old MacBook Air Retina (2020) that was able to run the last exported version from Godot 4.3 the game now crashes at startup. From my understanding it looks like it's failing to initialize the Vulkan Mobile renderer, which might be a limitation of the old hardware (though I did not expect this? Previous version have supported running vulkan mobile renderer). I can see the new 4.7.2 export says it's using Vulkan 1.2.334, and the old version log that it's supporting Vulkan 1.2.231, perhaps this is the reason it's failing? But the project is also configured to fall back to the compatibility renderer (Open GL 3) if Vulkan/Metal is unsupported, so I would have expected it to fall back to Open GL. But it doesn't and instead crashes with no error message shown. Seems more like a hardware specific incompatibility the engine startup might not handle correctly.
